label: Ridgeline Native Full Audit
changes: Walk routes from DOC's line (DocRoute), for every walk: DOC's pieces were joined greedily end to end from where the walk was tapped, so where a piece ends part way along another (Kepler Track: the Luxmore piece ends at Iris Burn Hut, half way along the valley piece, which starts 1 km on at Iris Burn Falls) the route jumped between piece ends and started at a side trip's end. Now the pieces form a network: split where one ends on another, touching ends merged, separate parts joined across their shortest gaps, a loop left open at its car park closed (ends within 1.5 km, far apart along the line). Dead-end branches are side trips. The route is, simplest first, the loop, the loop with an access track in and out, or the longest end-to-end path: the first within 10% of DOC's stated distance (else the nearest); with no stated distance, the loop when it is most of the line. Starts where DOC's line starts, the way DOC's line goes round. A network with several loops keeps DOC's pieces end to end from DOC's start.
Huts on side trips are listed too (near any of DOC's pieces), at the point their side trip leaves the route.

Checked on 46 multi-piece DOC walks (validation/doc-routes-2026-11-15/doc-routes-46-walks.txt): closer to DOC's distance on 7 walks, further on 5 (old routes took side trips by jumps), largest straight step never longer; Tongariro Alpine Crossing 0.3 km -> 18.8 km (DOC 20.2), Holdsworth to Kaitoke 14.3 -> 32.2 km (DOC 36), Hump Ridge 44.1 -> 53.8 km (DOC 61.5), Kepler 57.0 km loop from the control gates with Luxmore, Iris Burn and Moturau in order.
